_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: NEW: 'Add more courses' is now a Tight↔Loose CANDIDATE slider (the 'add more' you expected the strength bar to do) — drag toward Loose and more courses SIMILAR to the one you're merging appear in the list as unchecked rows (ranked by title, and by catalog description once that file loads on a deep loosen). The keyword box beside it GUIDES the search (type 'ESL'/'welding' to pull in specific courses). On both the per-row ⚇ dock and the worklist. Heads-up: the worklist now shows TWO sliders — the top Cons↔Aggr one (how many SUGGESTIONS to review) and this per-merge Tight↔Loose one (candidates for THIS merge). Tell me if that reads as one slider too many, or if the default (starts Tight, you opt into more) + the title-vs-description balance feel right.

Per-row ⚇ Merge (from any CCR row) now opens the SAME docked sidebar as ✨ Suggested merges — same roomy panel, same editor (the new candidate slider + keyword search, ⌕ merge-into-a-different-course up by the title, Beg/Int/Adv/Lab level filters). It drops the queue-only bits that don't apply to one course (no Skip/Keep, no N-of-M, no Cons↔Aggr suggestion slider). Try merging a specific course this way and tell me if it feels right.

Two fixes to try: (1) the Conservative↔Aggressive strength slider now reaches all the way to 0.00 on the Aggressive end (drag fully right = surface EVERY suggested group). (2) the 'I clicked Save and nothing happened' issue is gone — Confirm now stays greyed-out until at least two courses are ticked (with opt-in checkboxes only the ★ survivor starts checked, so you tick the ones to fold in). Flag anything that still feels off.

Merge editor tidy-up: 'Merge into a different existing course' moved UP under the course title (so you can redirect to a specific course right away when working out of order), and the long gray explainer paragraphs are now tucked behind small ⓘ hover icons to save space. The 'Add more courses' search now drops matches straight into the candidate list as UNCHECKED rows — tick the ones to merge, ignore the rest (no separate add step). Say the word if you want any of that copy back on-screen.

Carry-over from S70 (still worth doing): the worklist now groups WORD VARIANTS — 'Conversational Japanese' ↔ 'Japanese Conversation', 'Assisting' ↔ 'Assistant' (~866 more group). Confirm the clean language-conversation families when you get a chance. Where a group shows an amber '⚠ Spans N disciplines' note, eyeball it for homonyms (music vs office 'keyboard') before confirming.
Standing bonus: we'll keep adding Arroyo-Seco-style California plein-air landscapes (Redmond, Guy Rose, Wendt, Payne) to First Light — flag any artist/work you'd love and we'll source it.

When the merge wave settles (NOT per-merge): the unverified-M-ID renumber re-mint — close gaps + re-sort 001,002… by title within each (canonical SUBJ4, band). Full Rule-7, unverified-only, ONE pass.
